summary: Frontend-only verification of WebGL context-loss recovery flow. All code paths in engine.js and Game.jsx verified against spec; end-to-end Playwright test forcing WEBGL_lose_context succeeded: overlay appears with 'GRAPHICS HICCUP / Your GPU dropped its context. Reloading to recover…' text and page auto-reloads within ~2.2s to a healthy canvas. Regression check: healthy practice match loads with 0 overlay instances. Backend testing skipped per request.

verifications.engine_js_line_39_renderer: PASS — THREE.WebGLRenderer constructed with powerPreference: 'high-performance' and failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat: false (engine.js:41-54).
verifications.engine_js_context_lost_listener: PASS — canvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost') calls ev.preventDefault(), sets this._contextLost=true, dispatches onLocalUpdate({type:'webgl-context-lost'}) (engine.js:65-69).
verifications.engine_js_loop_guard: PASS — _loop skips _update + renderer.render when this._contextLost, just calls _scheduleFrame() and returns (engine.js:5696-5699).
verifications.game_jsx_handler: PASS — webgl-context-lost sets hud.glLost=Date.now() then setTimeout(window.location.reload, 2200) (Game.jsx:264-273); webgl-context-restored clears glLost (Game.jsx:274-280).
verifications.game_jsx_overlay_jsx: PASS — data-testid='webgl-recover-overlay' full-screen black overlay with animate-spin ring and 'GRAPHICS HICCUP' + 'Reloading to recover…' text (Game.jsx:714-729).
verifications.e2e_simulated_context_loss: PASS — WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext() triggered from Playwright; overlay appeared within 2.5s window with correct 'GRAPHICS HICCUP\nYour GPU dropped its context. Reloading to recover…' text.
verifications.e2e_auto_reload: PASS — Page reloaded within ~2.2s; URL preserved as /play?mode=offline; canvas re-initialized; overlay count=0 after reload.
verifications.regression_healthy_flow: PASS — Practice → Offline vs AI → Random map → START loads game; healthy overlay count=0 during normal gameplay; no console errors from context-loss code path.

critical_code_review_comments: engine.js is 5886 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into focused modules (renderer setup, arena builder, weapons, network sync, humanoid meshes, HUD hooks) for maintainability. Not blocking for this iteration but strongly recommended.

The WebGL recovery implementation is well-commented and correctly follows the WebGL best practice (preventDefault → attempt restore, but fall back to full page reload because Three.js buffers/textures don't reliably re-upload). Sound design choice.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WebGL context-loss recovery fix verified end-to-end. If retesting, use: (1) login admin@shooter.com/admin123, (2) PRACTICE → OFFLINE VS AI → START, (3) wait ~7s for countdown, (4) page.evaluate to fire WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext(), (5) expect data-testid='webgl-recover-overlay' within 2.5s, (6) expect reload ~2.2s after loss. Console logs during test contained only pre-login 401s (expected — /api/auth/me before authentication).
